name: test-verdict-then-invalid
description: Test fixture: records a respond (and optionally a block) verdict and then returns a grantless request replacement, so the refused output must discard the non-block verdicts like a trap while the block fails closed

permissions.name: env.respond_request
permissions.description: Record a respond verdict before the invalid replacement

permissions.name: env.block_request
permissions.description: Record a block verdict before the invalid replacement
